definitions.explanation: An academic rank at Japanese universities, one step below a full professor. This title replaced the older term {助教授|じょきょうじゅ} in 2007.

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}{准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}の{授業|じゅぎょう}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I took Associate Professor Tanaka's class.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{去年|きょねん}{准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}に{昇進|しょうしん}した。
examples.english: She was promoted to associate professor last year.

examples.japanese: {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}の{准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}として{研究|けんきゅう}を{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: He continues his research as an associate professor in the Faculty of Economics.

notes:
Replaced the older title {助教授|じょきょうじゅ} (assistant professor) in 2007 as part of academic title reforms. The change aimed to align Japanese academic ranks more closely with international standards. The current academic hierarchy at Japanese universities is: {教授|きょうじゅ} > {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ} > {講師|こうし} > {助教|じょきょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}に{就任|しゅうにん}する — to be appointed associate professor
- {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ}に{昇進|しょうしん}する — to be promoted to associate professor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {助教授|じょきょうじゅ} — assistant professor (old title, replaced by {准教授|じゅんきょうじゅ} in 2007)
- {教授|きょうじゅ} — professor (full)
- {助教|じょきょう} — assistant professor (current lowest faculty rank)
- {講師|こうし} — lecturer
